card.name: Inside rare drug and name pieces
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of rare words, such as 'ios' after 'n' (anhydramnios-type terms), 'io' in thiothixene or thiosulfate, and 'RO' in nitroglycerin. Also fires inside unusual personal names.

modes.label: Drug and medical word pieces
modes.description: A short piece partway through a drug or medical term, often right after an initial letter or two.

modes.label: Personal name pieces
modes.description: A short piece inside an uncommon surname in a citation or credit.

card.plain: It lights up on small chunks inside rare drug names and odd surnames, not on whole common words.
